description: 勞保局「投保單位網路申報及查詢作業」功能簡介 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 勞動部勞工保險局. 勞工保險局e化服務系統「投保單位網路申報及查詢作業」勞（就、職）保投保單位、農保投保單位功能簡介. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 勞動部勞工保險局. Its tags are 求職及就業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv, json, webservices, xml. The portal shows 2024-09-26 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
